chunks: Zurārah and ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
That he was asked about the salat over a child: when should salat be performed over him? So he said: “When he understands salat.”
So I said: when does salat become obligatory upon him? He said: “When he is a son of six years, and sawm is when he is capable of it.”

key_terms.أَطَاقَهُ: was able to bear it or capable of it
key_terms.ٱلصَّبِيِّ: the child about whom the ruling is being asked
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةِ: salat, referring here both to funeral prayer and the prescribed prayer

ai.seo_question: When is funeral salat offered for a child, and when do salat and sawm become obligatory?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a child in relation to funeral salat, daily salat, and sawm. It states that funeral salat is performed for the child when the child understands salat, that salat becomes obligatory at six years, and that sawm depends on the child's capability.
